spec.claim_summary: System trades price against its slowest moving average with confirmation across ten timeframes.
spec.untestable_reason: No MA lengths, entry trigger, trade direction, or exits are defined and the core 10-timeframe alignment is not expressible as a single-timeframe rule.
assumptions: No asset was named; assumed BTCUSDT as placeholder test universe.
No timeframe was named; assumed 1d as placeholder single timeframe.
No moving-average type or length was stated for 'lowest Moving average' / 'slowest tracking average'.
No entry trigger, cross direction, or long/short direction was stated; direction set to long as placeholder.
No exit, stop, target, or holding period was stated.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: confirmation/alignment across 10 different time frames, described as the core of the system, which requires multi-timeframe conditions.
